concerns.text: FR-003 requires the system to compute 3D energy spectra and structure functions but does not specify how the correctness of these computations will be measured (e.g., expected output dimensions, tolerance against an analytical benchmark, or reproducibility checks). Add explicit, quantitative verification criteria.

FR-005 mandates power‑law fitting and separation of two comparison targets, yet it lacks measurable thresholds (such as a minimum R², confidence‑interval width, or separate validation checks for each target). Provide concrete, testable criteria to confirm the fitting is performed correctly and the targets are not conflated.
